request.style: English, soul, warm female solo voice with soft choir, acoustic piano, upright bass, light drums, brushed cymbals, gentle, 78 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Come to me, all you who are weary
And burdened by the weight of the day
I will give you a deep, sweet rest
For the soul that is tired and heavy

[Chorus]
Take my yoke upon you and learn from me
For I am gentle and humble in heart
You will find rest for your souls
In this quiet and sacred place

[Verse]
My yoke is easy and my burden is light
No one knows the Son except the Father
No one knows the Father except the Son
And those to whom the Son chooses to reveal him

[Chorus]
Take my yoke upon you and learn from me
For I am gentle and humble in heart
You will find rest for your souls
In this quiet and sacred place

[Bridge]
All things have been entrusted to me by my Father
Yes, Father, for this was your good pleasure
Come to me, all you who are weary
And I will give you rest

[Chorus]
Take my yoke upon you and learn from me
For I am gentle and humble in heart
You will find rest for your souls
In this quiet and sacred place

[Outro]
My yoke is easy
And my burden is light
